$description: Sheet's tokens (plan 0006 §0s). The build generates styles/components/kinds/sheet.css and sheet.generated.ts from the sheet group.

sheet.$description: Styles the content panel. Each variant is a surface role read from the family in scope; the old presets map to: default → elevated; glass → glass + deep; stark → stark + glow; flat → flat + minimal; matte → neuro + solid. The trigger, overlay and close button carried the panel's family markers by accident (the close button inherited the panel's background, border and shadow); they no longer do. The overlay keeps what those markers gave it: no paint, over the browser's popover canvas.

close.$description: Today's look kept: the close button wears the panel's surface (it inherited the panel's variables, which drew a faint ring around the ✕). Reads the panel's --sheet-* properties, which it inherits.
